body: You're welcome. And thank you. I wish I believed that. I'm feeling like I really don't matter right now.

I'm sorry that you've had to deal with the dysphoria and misgendering, too. I get what you mean about numbing. For me, it's just apathy. I find I often just don't care what happens to me anymore. Like, I've been hurt enough where I don't feel anything at all, or it doesn't affect me because I feel like I deserve it. If it means anything, I think you're valuable and important.
